package rulefixtures

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
)

// scenario for hmac_new_in_loop: `hmac.New(...)` inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func signMessages(msgs []string, key []byte) []string {
	sigs := make([]string, 0, len(msgs))
	for _, msg := range msgs {
		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
		mac.Write([]byte(msg))
		sigs = append(sigs, hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil)))
	}
	return sigs
}
